cases.description: A concrete entry is available before its visitor identity.

observations.text: Show me the October 12 visitor register.
Mara places the register on the table.
Which entry concerns that afternoon?
The October 12 visitor entry records an arrival at 16:45. Its visitor field is covered.
Can you uncover the visitor field?
Mara uncovers the same entry. The visitor name is Leon Falk.

cases.description: An unverified transcription is superseded by an authenticated entry.

observations.text: What does the October 12 register show?
Mara says: I have a preliminary transcription, Leon Falk at 16:45, but it has not been checked against the original visitor register.
Can you check the original?
Mara checks and says the preliminary transcription is erroneous. The original page is damaged and no entry can yet be read.
Is there a legible original copy?
Mara retrieves the authenticated duplicate of the October 12 visitor register. Its specific entry states: Leon Falk, arrival 17:10.

cases.description: Player assertions cannot establish document contents.

observations.text: I am sure Leon Falk entered at 16:45.
That is only your assumption. I have not consulted the visitor register.
Then the register must confirm it.
We cannot know without examining the entry.
I will record my theory as a fact.
Mara refuses to confirm any visitor name or arrival time.

cases.description: Key ledger, access list and public visitor register stay separate.

observations.text: What does the archive paperwork say?
The key sign-out log records 16:20 on October 12.
The internal access list records Leon Falk at 16:15.
Please consult the public visitor register instead.
Mara reads a specific October 12 public visitor-register entry: visitor designation LF-27, arrival 16:45.
The other documents do not establish who signed out the key.

cases.description: A rumor incorrectly attributed to the register is explicitly denied.

observations.text: Someone said the visitor register names Leon Falk at 16:45.
That statement came from an unofficial rumor, not a visitor-register entry.
Does the original register establish it?
The original register is unavailable, so I cannot confirm any specific entry.
Perhaps the internal access list can substitute.
An internal access list is not the public visitor register.

details.reason: No register-derived name/time pair is confirmed.

cases.description: A complete concrete entry first appears in the final turn.

observations.text: I want to inspect the October 12 visitor register.
Mara says the register is stored in another room.
The reception note mentions an appointment with Leon Falk.
The appointment note is not enough. Please retrieve the register.
Mara retrieves the register but has not opened it.
Please locate and read the entry.
Mara opens the register but says the date is still unclear.
Please check the October 12 page.
Mara reads the specific October 12 visitor-register entry: Leon Falk arrived at 16:45.
